listing.name: Kazeron Avionics 1.3b (and Sierra Addon 1.0)
listing.summary: An aggressive and carrier-focused Midline ship-and-wing pack inspired by Diable Avionics, featuring the following: 4 new battlecarriers, one for each hull type (Vent, Rafale, Trombe, Ouragan) and 1 civilian auxiliary cruiser (Alruna), all sporting the ACE Combat Suite shipsystem (+25% timeflow, -33% damage taken, enable direct control of deployed wings);
listing.aiSummary: Adds a carrier-focused Midline faction featuring battlecarriers, EWAR platforms, wings, strikecrafts, and new weapons.

description: Introduces four new battlecarriers with the ACE Combat Suite, an EWAR platform, seven wings, and five pilotable strikecrafts. Includes five modular weapons, a Magcoil Mounts hullmod, and a custom Nex start. Ships appear in Persean League and Independent markets.

changelog.1.3b:
Removed the tags from the various fighter hulls, hopefully stopping them from showing up on Arms Dealers menus;
 Halved the mini Hammerhead's shield capacity (4100 -> 2050); if it remains too tough for comfort, further nerfs are on the table.
changelog.1.3a: Nothing much happened, just a DP bump up to 35 for the Joyeuse (as was originally intended, before the .csv curse struck).
changelog.1.3:
The Joyeuse-class BC is here! A very fast and very fragile battlecruiser meant to prowl the edges of formations, bombard (and/or bomb) exposed targets with its heavy armament, and back off before retaliation comes for its squishy Retribution-like hull. Comes with a special hullmod to ensure it can fire and fade better.
 The Ouragan-class BB has seen a considerable increase in armament, statline, and DP cost as to better differentiate it from the Joyeuse. It's still somewhat fragile for its displacement, but the amount of firepower it can fill the horizon with should make up for it.
 The Flamberge DCA was somewhat retooled; +4 ammo to make it work better with Expanded Magazines, a much longer delay between bursts (0.75s), longer reload time (it goes with the increased mag capacity), slightly reduced recoil per shot because of the increased ammo count
 NOT save compatible due to the Ouragan changes.
